an4.126:1.1: cattārome bhikkhave puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ.
an4.126:1.3: idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo mettāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharati. tathā dutiyaṃ - tathā tatiyaṃ - tathā catutthiṃ.- iti uddhamadho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ mettāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjhena pharitvā viharati.
an4.126:1.4: so yadeva tattha hoti rūpagataṃ vedanāgataṃ saññāgataṃ saṅkhāragataṃ viññāṇagataṃ, te dhamme aniccato dukkhato rogato gaṇḍato sallato aghato ābādhato parato palokato suññato anattato samanupassati.
an4.126:1.5: so kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā suddhāvāsānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjati.
an4.126:1.6: ayaṃ kho bhikkhave upapatti asādhāraṇā puthujjanehi.
an4.126:2.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave idhekacco puggalo karuṇāsahagatena cetasā …pe…
an4.126:2.3: upekkhāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharati. tathā dutiyaṃ - tathā tatiyaṃ - tathā catutthiṃ. iti uddhamadho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ upekkhāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjhena pharitvā viharati.
an4.126:2.4: so yadeva tattha hoti rūpagataṃ vedanāgataṃ saññāgataṃ saṅkhāragataṃ viññāṇagataṃ te dhamme aniccato dukkhato rogato gaṇḍato sallato aghato ābādhato parato palokato suññato anattato samanupassati.
an4.126:2.5: so kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā suddhāvāsānaṃ devānaṃsahavyataṃ upapajjati.
an4.126:2.7: ime kho bhikkhave cattāro puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasminti.
